activities.title: Lab 1 Part B: find it, snip it, file it
activities.intro: Use your master folder from Part A. Find a page on the official BIR website, take a screenshot and save it in the right folder.

items: Search "internet safety tips". Then try site:bir.gov.ph with a topic you choose.
Open one useful page on the official BIR website (check the address!).
Press Win + Shift + S and drag around the useful part.
Click the pop-up that appears, then press Ctrl + S to save.
Save it into 01 Screenshots as YYYY-MM-DD Screenshot - BIR Website.

blocks.prompt: Look at the address of the page you opened. Type the domain, the part just before the first single "/".
Which keys open the snip tool so you can drag around part of the screen?
Which folder did you save your screenshot into?

help: The pop-up disappeared? Open the Snipping Tool from Start, or paste with Ctrl + V into Paint and save.
Check the address: your page must be on bir.gov.ph.
Other ways to capture: PrtSc for the whole screen, Win + PrtSc to save it to Pictures › Screenshots, or right-click an image › Save image as. On a Mac: Cmd + Shift + 4.

activities.title: Quick check: the right search
activities.intro: One question. Pick the best answer.

blocks.prompt: You want only PDF files about data privacy, from government websites. Which search?
